findings.issue_summary: Foreground services are declared and implemented, requiring Play Console declaration.
findings.evidence: Manifest declares foregroundServiceType attributes. WearableStreamingService calls startForeground(). MainViewModel calls startForegroundService().
findings.recommendation: Play Console Declaration Required: For apps targeting Android 14+, you must complete a Foreground Service declaration in the Play Console (App content section) for each type used, providing a functional description, user impact video, and a specific use case selection.

findings.issue_summary: App requests broad RECORD_AUDIO permission for occasional, user-initiated vocal input.
findings.evidence: MainActivity requests RECORD_AUDIO. WearableStreamingService uses AudioRecord in a recording loop triggered by user interactions.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to the Android Microphone Button API to process temporary audio securely.
